1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein the polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is formulated for delayed release of a crosslinking agent in an oil and gas reservoir environment__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __for delayed gelling applications__.

3. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein the composition is formulated for use in oil and gas field applications__.

8. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex __nanoparticle has__ an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter __and is configured for controlled release of crosslinking agents__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater __and provide delayed gelling functionality__.

10. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine __of less than 2000 Da__ and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron __and being formulated for delayed release applications__.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __for delayed crosslinking in oil and gas applications__.

13. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al.

21. (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic sites__ that can be crosslinked with __the multivalent cation crosslinker from__ a); and c) a fluid.

22. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer.

23. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide __having a molecular weight greater than 100,000 Da__.

24. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or N,N-dimethylacrylamide.

26. (Previously presented) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.
